method: Oshima versus mean retained post-Oshima sites; omit each post island once; minimum two retained post sites
reading: The 8/8 full-subset direction is not a single-island artifact but is not uniformly leave-one-post-island invariant. Miyake contributes importantly to the coherence for Lysimachia and Melanthera, and Hachijo contributes for Melanthera.
claim_boundary: Descriptive robustness audit under shared site environments; not a species-independent sign test, causal estimate, or universal all-network-plant breakpoint.
